It’s a celebration of human endurance and Boston’s spirit — and you’ll feel like part of the city’s athletic legacy.

2. **Climb the Boston Common’s “Climb the Hill”** – While not a “sport,” this is a fun, scenic, and slightly challenging hike up the hill behind the Common. It’s a great way to get some exercise, enjoy panoramic views of the city, and soak in the historic atmosphere — all while avoiding the crowds of the marathon.
